biography.plain_text: Reinhold Knodel is a German property developer who founded PANDION and became its sole shareholder. Based in Cologne, he built a business developing and selling homes and offices in major German cities. He trained as a carpenter and police officer before studying business administration with a specialism in real estate.

long_biography.plain_text:
Property developer Reinhold Knodel made architectural competitions a regular part of PANDION's development process. He sought designs intended to remain attractive over decades, rather than reserving competitions for flagship buildings. He also held back from entering Frankfurt when he considered post-Brexit competition for sites too expensive, preferring locations where the company understood the market.

With his son Patrick, he established the foundation now known as ChanceMaker. Patrick leads its work supporting locally developed initiatives addressing poverty and environmental challenges. PANDION committed to funding programmes and covering administrative costs, so external donations could support projects. Its commitments also included matching those donations.
